records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Ridge Analytics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero tickets. Two Wrenfield outreach emails (email:49e7486b, email:34bc3ad4) got no reply, so there is no signal of engagement; Starter solo admin with silence rarely self-activates in 8 days.

draft.subject: One small next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Following up on my note last week — no reply needed, I just want to make the first step easy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project is usually the fastest way to see how it fits your team's work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through it with you and answer anything about getting your team set up.

Best,
Chidi
